title: Soundness of the Goldreich–Levin output
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, and let $0<\tau\le1$. Suppose rational estimates of the restricted Fourier weights of $f$ are within $\tau^2/4$ of their true values for every coordinate set and every subset of that set. If the Goldreich–Levin procedure with threshold $\tau$ returns a family $A$ of coordinate sets, then every $U\in A$ has Fourier coefficient satisfying $\tau/2<|\widehat f(U)|$.
hypotheses_covered: Every restricted Fourier weight estimate differs from its true value by less than $\tau^2/4$
The procedure's output is the family $A$
